question: For one 250 ms X11 key hold, does same-thread full-frame capture during the hold materially increase application-observed hold duration versus no capture?
fixture: Xvfb 1024x768x24 + Openbox + rendered Tk checkerboard + XTEST w key

conditions.none: one scheduled 250 ms hold, no capture
conditions.capture: same hold, full-frame Pillow ImageGrab at nominal 50/100/150/200 ms

harness_change_from_v1: append and fsync each completed case to rows.jsonl; scientific condition and thresholds unchanged; pairs reduced only to fit outer execution budget
primary_metric: paired capture-minus-none application-observed press-to-release duration in ms

decision.capture_cost_candidate: median paired delta >= 5 ms OR p95 paired delta >= 10 ms
decision.reject_as_primary_simple_fixture_explana: median paired delta < 5 ms AND p95 paired delta < 10 ms

scope: development mechanism isolation only; no ViZDoom, gameplay efficacy, model, planner, renewal, or shared-runtime claim
